messages:
harper: Heads-up — AcmeHealth submitted a request to onboard 'silverline-3b' (open weights) into Private. They want <=15ms p50 token latency, prefer q4_0 quant, need on‑prem packaging + KMS/HSM. Can eng-ml triage? Link: https://acme.ex/share/silverline

maya: Adding to triage. Any quick notes on tokenizer/format? :eyes:

oliver: I pulled the weights overnight. It's a standard decoder-only transformer ~3B params, HF format, SentencePiece tokenizer. No sharded custom ops. Did a tiny local q4_0 run — memory looks fine but no perf numbers yet.

ada: For Private/on‑prem we'll need a release tarball + model metadata + packaging checklist. Also flagging KMS work: ops/security will need SOC/NDA signoff before HSM keys are used. Which infra path — Dedicated pool or full Private VPC?

chris: We should run the standard eval harness: `python eval/bench.py --model silverline-3b --quant q4_0 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --metrics latency,perplexity` If someone can kick, I can watch and collect traces.

maya: Kicking now on gpu-ci-small slot: `job 98765` Command: `python eval/bench.py --model silverline-3b --quant q4_0 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-artifacts/silverline/98765/`

perf-bot: job 98765 started on gpu-ci-small (queue: low-prio)

perf-bot: job 98765 completed — p50=9.8ms p95=14.6ms mem=6.3GB throughput=45 tok/s. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/silverline/98765/ (logs + traces)

harper: :thumbsup: Good — p50 is within SLA, p95 is borderline. Action items:
1) oliver: run q5_0 and q8_0 smoke runs and post perf + quality diffs vs fp16 baseline.
2) maya: create a focused eval set from AcmeHealth sample prompts, run quality eval (perplexity + rouge/emd) and compare to fp16.
3) ada: estimate packaging timeline for on‑prem + KMS onboarding + security review.
4) chris: add to boarding board and mark P1 (solutions says timeline is ~2 weeks). I'll sync with solutions on contract specifics.

oliver: On it. I'll run q5_0 and q8_0 tonight and attach TPM traces.

maya: Noted. I asked solutions to share a 1000‑prompt sample — harper can you nudge them to include edge cases (medical abbreviations)?

harper: Pinged solutions@acmehealth — they uploaded `acme_silverline_prompts_v1.json` to the shared bucket (link above). Also asked for expected peak RPS and SLA windows (business hours vs 24/7).

perf-bot: scheduled new perf-run 98811 (q5_0)

perf-bot: run 98811 done — p50=11.2ms p95=15.7ms mem=5.1GB throughput=52 tok/s. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/silverline/98811/

ada: Packaging estimate: 3 business days for on‑prem tar + metadata + basic integration tests. KMS/HSM onboarding + security review: 5–7 business days after NDA + SOC docs. If customer needs accelerated lane we need signed docs and a security contact.

chris: Added ticket B-4192 to boarding board, owner: eng-ml oncall, priority: P1. Please add any follow-ups to that ticket.

harper: Thanks team. Plan: hold for maya's quality eval. If quality regressions vs fp16 exceed 2% (perplexity or key metrics) we pause quant rollout and try alternative quant profile. Otherwise proceed to packaging and cut release candidate. Reconvene after oliver/maya post results.
